purpose: Prove that V19DJ grouped source, background, ARF and RMF products become byte-identical across independent executions after removal of run-time-only FITS provenance, without changing any scored science array or consumer behavior.

decision.pass: Both registered cluster controls pass two independent full response-free PHA combinations, groupings and direct-response writes; canonical products preserve all scored arrays exactly, have valid deterministic FITS checksums, load and forward-fold in Sherpa, and are byte-identical across repetitions. A separately named canonicalized full commissioning successor may be frozen.
decision.fail: Do not rerun full commissioning, fit a spectrum, or open any source invariant. Retire this canonicalization implementation and diagnose the mismatch without changing the inherited science method.

claim_boundary: V19DK is a deterministic-serialization preflight, not a spectral or source result.
The two controls were already used in V19DI and open no new target.
No fit, temperature, thermodynamic stress, baroclinicity, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout result is opened.
A pass authorizes only a separately frozen full commissioning successor with unchanged V19X2 science gates.
